title: Cheesy Ethiopian Lasagna
description: A unique twist on traditional lasagna, this dish combines the flavors of Ethiopia with melted cheese.
instructions: Cook lasagna sheets according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a skillet, combine cheese, kicked sauce, and floral honey (if using). Stir until well combined.
Add Ethiopian spices to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture.
Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top of the cheese layer.
Repeat the cheese and lasagna layers two more times, ending with a cheese layer on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
